lesson_1791535948700.title: P2 Dictation (1) – Syllabus
lesson_1791535948700.text:
The After-School Inventor
My name is Clara Doodle. I invent things after school. I have a lot of new ideas and some of them are cool. Here are my rain glasses and my umbrella pen. Ok. Some ideas are not so good... but I always try again!

When I have an idea, I always make a plan. I draw and change, and change and draw. I do the best I can. Here's my smart eraser. It tells me when I'm wrong. And my alarm clock pillow wakes me with a song.

This is my special mirror. It changes what I see. When I click this button, I see the back of me. But something's not quite right! It's changing all my clothes. Oh, no! I have long purple hair and a big long nose. Mum says my room's a mess, but I don't like to clean. Here's my new invention... it's a big clean-up machine.

My Good Ideas Book
Write your ideas down. A lot of them! Choose a good one. When you have a problem, look for a solution. Look at animals and plants. They can give you good ideas. Draw a picture of your idea. Drawing helps you to see your idea. When you see a problem, you can change it. Show your idea to your friends and family. Listen to what they say and maybe change your idea.
